research_task.title: Deliver and audit the exact manifest-pinned orbit bundle

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the fresh permitted attempt had no supplier-authored top-level SHA-256 manifest or orbit-pruning payload at first inventory, so the ordered offline verification protocol stopped before execution.

value_assessment.novelty: Relative to the directly linked unreviewed prior contribution, this independently reproduces its missing-delivery obstruction in a fresh attempt with a distinct brief digest. The advertised material delivery did not occur; this changes no payload state and contradicts no mathematical, compiler, replay, or count claim.
value_assessment.evidence: A hidden-inclusive non-executing inventory found exactly four ordinary root files and no directories: one pre-existing 9,919-byte brief with SHA-256 61fb0e81bc35ff2f6e0db4b4705894db79b247639e267708f294c41e79ac13f6, followed in time by the three reviewer-authored records. An independent direct-filesystem enumeration agreed; the root was not a reparse point, and the brief had one ordinary data stream and none of the tested embedded-payload markers. The structured record passed exact-key, enum, and task-bound validation.
value_assessment.falsifier: An inventory showing a pre-existing ordinary root SHA-256 manifest and its complete payload, followed by successful coverage and digest validation, would overturn this scoped missing-delivery result.

claims.statement: Within the observable permitted attempt at first inventory, no supplier-authored ordinary root SHA-256 manifest or orbit-pruning payload was present; therefore the ordered protocol was blocked before contributed-code execution.
claims.evidence_summary: The complete inventory had four ordinary files and no directories. The sole pre-existing item was the brief; the other three were initialized by this review. Independent direct-filesystem enumeration agreed; the root was not a reparse point, and the brief had only its ordinary data stream with none of the tested digest, fence, project-file, or common archive-prefix markers. The claim depends only on confined filesystem visibility and timestamp-based temporal classification. It does not address artifacts elsewhere or assert human identity.
claims.verification_method: Read the brief first, initialize the mandated records, enumerate all root and recursive entries including hidden entries without executing them, record type, size, time, and SHA-256, reproduce the enumeration through an independent filesystem API, inspect root and stream metadata, and scan the brief as inert text for specified common payload indicators.

limitations: The observation is confined to this permitted attempt and does not show whether a bundle exists elsewhere.
Timestamp ordering establishes only that the brief predates the review records, not who authored it.
No build, declaration audit, axiom audit, replay, count comparison, or mutation test was reached.
The content-marker checks are limited to specified common indicators and are not a general decoder for arbitrary steganographic or encoded data.
failed_approaches: Manifest coverage and digest validation could not start because no supplied manifest candidate or payload entry appeared in the inventory.
All execution stages were intentionally withheld because the protocol requires successful inventory and digest validation first.
An adversarial search for a concealed delivery route found no reparse-point root, alternate brief stream, digest, code fence, project-file marker, or common Base64 archive prefix.
next_actions: Place the complete attributable manifest-pinned bundle into a new permitted attempt before reviewer records are initialized, then rerun the ordered offline protocol.

proposed_tasks.title: Verify a materially imported orbit-pruning bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: In a fresh permitted attempt that already contains the exact attributable payload and top-level SHA-256 manifest, validate every digest and execute the full offline audit in order.
proposed_tasks.rationale: Repeated review attempts are blocked at delivery; exact bytes must precede any meaningful compiler, axiom, replay, or mutation evidence.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Every required file is manifest-covered with a matching digest; the offline build and axiom audit meet the declared contract; two clean replays agree; and independent changed-input and changed-count mutations are rejected.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Preserve the first coverage gap, digest mismatch, offline dependency or compiler failure, unexpected axiom, declaration mismatch, replay disagreement, count mismatch, or accepted mutation.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Inventory without execution, validate manifest coverage and SHA-256 digests, build without networking, print declarations and axioms, replay twice from clean generated state, then separately mutate input and expected count.
